        for swap in [(a,c,b,d), (a,d,b,c)]:
            u1, v1, u2, v2 = swap
            if len({u1, v1, u2, v2}) < 4:
                continue
            
            # Check no duplicate edges
            e1 = (min(u1, v1), max(u1, v1))
            e2 = (min(u2, v2), max(u2, v2))
            if e1 == e2:
                continue
            
            new_edges_set = set(edges)
            new_edges_set.discard((min(a,b), max(a,b)))
            new_edges_set.discard((min(c,d), max(c,d)))
            if e1 in new_edges_set or e2 in new_edges_set:
                continue
            new_edges_set.add(e1)
            new_edges_set.add(e2)
            
            new_edges = list(new_edges_set)
            
            new_adj = defaultdict(set)
            for u, v in new_edges:
                new_adj[u].add(v)
                new_adj[v].add(u)
            
            new_girth = compute_girth(new_adj, n)
            
            if new_girth > best_girth:
                best_edges = new_edges[:]
                best_girth = new_girth
                edges = new_edges
                adj = new_adj
                break
            elif new_girth == best_girth and random.random() < 0.05:
                edges = new_edges
                adj = new_adj
                break
    
    return best_edges, best_girth
